product.name: Stage Right by Monoprice 12in x 12in Truss Totem Top Base Plate with Hardware for 8in Box Aluminum Lighting Truss
product.description: Truss totems (or truss towers) are a very popular and practical configuration of lighting truss. Intended for use with our 8" truss, the Stage Right™ Top Base Plate sits on top of a vertical truss, creating a solid base for mounting lighting fixtures. It is made of aluminum to match the look and finish of the standard 8" truss. Mounting hardware is included.Disclaimer: This product is prone to cosmetic finish imperfections and my scratch easily, as well as show signs of scratching from the factory.Support Files: User's Manual (Jan 13, 2020)Monoprice™, Stage Right™, the Stage Right logo, and all Monoprice logos are trademarks of Monoprice Inc.
